original_record_metadata_exposure.command:
OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 .venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, hashlib, sys, platform, torch
print(json.dumps({'python':sys.version,'torch':str(torch.__version__),'torch_file':torch.__file__,'device':'cpu','platform':platform.platform()},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
for p in ('docs/course-experiments/results/tools.json','docs/course-experiments/releases/tools.json','docs/course-experiments/public-releases/tools.json'):
 b=pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes();d=json.loads(b)
 print(p,hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest())
 print('keys', list(d))
 for k in ('results','code_sha256','source','source_result','revision','evaluation','files','exports','model_config','source_record','release','public_files','artifacts'):
  if k in d:
   v=d[k]
   print(k,'keys' if isinstance(v,dict) else 'length',list(v) if isinstance(v,dict) else len(v) if isinstance(v,list) else v)
PY
